scope: Local implementation on main, uncommitted, preserving pre-existing CI/postgame/presentation changes

checks: Room text/emoji, safe HTML, anonymous filter notice, retained rejected draft, player mention, reaction and mute across reload
Continuous game chat, route reference highlights without wagons/state mutation, unread badge and reconnect history
Spectators read during play and can write after the game ends
Desktop, phone portrait and landscape composer stay within the viewport
alsoVerified: Spectator exits and reenters the same room through the same WebSocket
Mute and unmute menus work at all three viewports

checks: Public construction score matches owner/rival/spectator; private breakdown only belongs to owner

Distinct phone/tablet/desktop layouts: permanent sidebar and hand/destinations on larger screens; phone portrait/landscape preserved; unique controls and unchanged renderer across rotations; 44px market/tools and stable camera on panel open
Rules derive match values; chat opens with enabled composer; keyboard opens full hand and Escape closes panels
Two real draws update authoritative hand, second-draw hint and active clock; rival draws preserve reading position with unread/scrollbar; history route focuses and returns camera
Actual route payment updates ownership/score/trains and triggers the final round at exactly two remaining trains; English rule help
optional recount categories and immutable result

limits: All HTTP/WebSocket/browser servers used isolated temporary file state and random local ports.
Remote commit delay/failure/lost-response scenarios used fake Supabase; no production service was contacted.
The ES/EN filter is lexical and can miss contextual harassment or produce false positives; human abuse reports remain deferred.
No native phone testing, production latency measurement or remote CI run was performed.
